title: Body and Soul: Decoupling Robotic Brain and Policy with RoboHarness-Zero
abstract: arXiv:2611.30550v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies can execute individual skills but fail to complete tasks that require combining several of them. In our audit of Xiaomi-Robotics-1, an estimated 43\% of failures involve choosing the wrong target or losing track of task progress. Wrapping a frozen VLA in a vision-language model (VLM) harness is a natural remedy. Existing harnesses can gain substantially from task- and policy-specific preparation, raising the question of how much of that gain transfers to a new task or policy. An ideal harness should (i) need minimal preparation for a new task, (ii) need no redesign for a new policy, and (iii) preserve standalone capabilities the policy already has. translated_title: 躯体与灵魂：用 RoboHarness-Zero 解耦机器人“大脑”与策略
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略能够执行单项技能，但在完成需要组合多项技能的任务时往往失败。在对 Xiaomi-Robotics-1 的审计中，我们估计约 43% 的失败源于选错目标或丢失任务进度。将一个冻结的 VLA 包裹在视觉-语言模型（VLM）框架中是一种自然的补救方法。现有框架可以从针对特定任务和特定策略的准备工作中获得显著收益，由此引出一个问题：这些收益中有多少能迁移到新任务或新策略上。理想的框架应当：(i) 面对新任务只需极少准备，(ii) 面对新策略无需重新设计，(iii) 保留策略本身已具备的独立能力。据我们所知，RoboHarness-Zero 是首个按此方式构建的框架。其前提假设是：对于像 GPT-6 这样的 VLM 而言，无需任务准备即可轻松完成目标选择和进度跟踪，而冻结的 VLA 本身已能处理连续的、接触性的（原文在此截断）
tldr: 提出首个零准备、可跨任务跨策略复用的机器人框架 RoboHarness-Zero，通过将冻结的 VLA 策略与 VLM“大脑”解耦——由 VLM 负责目标选择与任务进度跟踪——实现多技能组合，同时保留策略原有的独立能力。
en_tdlr: RoboHarness-Zero is the first zero-preparation, task- and policy-agnostic harness that decouples a frozen VLA policy from a VLM "brain" handling target selection and task progress tracking, enabling multi-skill task completion while preserving the policy's standalone capabilities.
